evidence: Full CDIAL vatsa explicitly gives Gawri ēċī cow and derives it from vatsikā, citing NOGaw 27; it also gives West Pahari bachī cow and several heifer forms. The survey Gawri heʦī cow fits that directly documented lexical family. Initial h and affricate notation remain as elicited and are not silently regularized to the dictionary form. The source itself supplies the adult cow sense; regional transmission remains qualified.
